description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。**ClientToken**只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
description.en: Ensures the idempotence of the request. Generate a value from your client that is unique across different requests. **ClientToken** supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

descriptions.zh:
### 前提条件
请先确认服务商在创建服务时开启变配功能并完成变配参数设置。
descriptions.en:
### Before you begin
Make sure that the service provider has enabled the Upgrade/Downgrade feature and completed the specification change parameter settings when creating the service.
